lessons: Narrow the guard in clutch/stages.py implement_inputs: read `text = (repo / context_path(p)).read_text()` outside the try, then wrap only `context_excerpt(p, text)` in `except ValueError`. Both helpers already exist in clutch/tickets.py; leave that file unchanged.

UnicodeDecodeError is a subclass of ValueError, so it must not become the notice. A non-UTF-8 Context file and a missing file must still raise as before. Definition of rejected: do not swallow errors other than the selector ValueError.

In tests/unit/test_stages_context_unresolved.py, add a tmp_path case: a Context file with invalid UTF-8 bytes makes implement_inputs raise UnicodeDecodeError. Keep the existing criteria 1-4 tests, and use only tmp_path so the coverage floor on stages.py still holds.
